text:
ashvin: heads-up — preview dashboard shows a small but consistent spike where the same request_id is being charged twice when it falls back to nearline. past 15m for a few tenants. dumping logs below.

ashvin: ```
2024-11-01T08:12:03Z request_id=rc_9a7f route=primary tally=1
2024-11-01T08:12:03Z request_id=rc_9a7f route=fallback nearline=1
```

devon: is this coming from the new tally-service v2 rollout? it should dedupe by request_id, maybe TTL/hashing mismatch between in-memory cache and nearline index. @maria any ideas?

maria: quick check — we moved prefix-hash -> 64bit in tally v2 to reduce collisions; nearline ingest still normalizes to 32bit. that would cause dedupe misses (same logical request maps to different keys).

tara: ugh. console is surfacing both as "committed" counts in preview which inflates projected invoice numbers. we should mark nearline-derived counts as "approximate" until reconciliation.

devon: two approaches: 1) normalize to 32bit at tally emit time (fast deploy but reintroduces collision risk) or 2) normalize on nearline ingest (one deploy, safer). which is lower blast radius?

maria: normalization on nearline is lower blast radius — single service change, no live rollback of tally. i'll open a PR to cast to lower32 on ingest and keep an eye on histograms.

maria: config snippet i'm proposing for nearline ingestion:```yaml
nearline: ingest_window_ms: 2000
         dedupe_prefix_bits: 32
         dedupe_ttl_s: 60
```

ashvin: sgtm. for UX: tara — can you sketch a tiny console change? e.g., orange "approx" pill next to nearline totals and hover text explaining reconciliation lag. we should also add an alert for preview vs committed drift.

tara: yep. mock: show two columns (Committed | Preview) with a small tooltip: "Preview includes nearline, may be reconciled later; values marked APPROX when reconciliation pending." will add to the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:

metering-bot: Reconciler job finished: 2024-11-01T09:00:00Z drift_pct=0.018%. next_run=2024-11-01T10:00:00Z

devon: i'll add an alert query draft: `((sum(preview_count) - sum(committed_count)) / sum(committed_count)) > 0.01 for 5m` and a runbook to flip preview hide for >1% deviation per tenant.

ashvin: thanks all. maria — ping here when PR is up. devon/tara — coordinate console alert + flag so we can toggle preview per-tenant until reconciliation catches up.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood/nearline/pull/785 — adds 32bit normalization + unit tests. will roll canary to eu-west first.

tara: filing console ticket and adding to canary checklist.

ashvin: closing loop: once reconciler shows <0.5% for 2 runs we can remove the orange "approx" UI and re-enable preview by default. thanks everyone.
